notes.title: Windows10 users
notes.notes:
If you have a black screen and only sound when you start the game on Win10, please do the following :

* Right click insect.exe in the game folder.
* Click "Compatibility" tab.
* Set "Compatibility mode" to "Windows XP Service Pack 3".
* Apply and quit.
